subject: POC timeline & milestones - Nova Software
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novasoft.com>, Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@novasoft.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC timeline & milestones - Nova Software

Hi Sanjay / Claire,

Great to meet you both this morning. Quick recap + proposed plan from our discovery so we can align on success criteria and next steps for the POC. I captured action owners and a tentative timeline below.

1) Success criteria (what Nova needs to prove):
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 400ms on representative queries.
- Cost: token cost per query under target we discussed (rough target: $0.008/op).
- Quality: >= 85% pass rate on the supplied evaluation set (see evaluation plan).
- Integration: end-to-end example workflow integrated into Nova's staging environment with SSO and sample dataset.

2) Evaluation plan:
- Nova will provide a 250-query evaluation set (mix of short/long prompts + structured/output checks) by 2026-11-24.
- Redwood will run automated evals daily during the POC and provide a short scorecard every Friday.
- We'll do a final blind readout using the evaluation set on the last day.

3) Proposed timeline & milestones (kickoff -> final readout):
- 2026-11-29: POC kickoff meeting (60 min) — introductions, infra access, walk through success criteria and test plan.
- Week 1 (11/30 - 12/06): Integration and data upload; basic smoke tests. Weekly check-in #1 (12/03).
- Week 2 (12/07 - 12/13): Performance tuning and caching/batching experiments. Weekly check-in #2 (12/10).
- Week 3 (12/14 - 12/20): Finalize evaluation runs, regression checks, and quality tuning. Final readout (12/20).

4) Ownership & contacts:
- Redwood PM / CSM: Marissa Cole (me) — program lead, weekly check-ins, executive readout.
- Redwood SE: Connor O'Brien — model tuning, infra onboarding.
- Redwood infra lead: Michael Grant — staging capacity and access.
- Nova infra contact: (please confirm who will own SSO/credential provisioning).

5) Immediate asks (by EOD 11/24 unless otherwise noted):
- Nova: share evaluation set (250 queries) and a short list of 10 high-priority prompts for early smoke tests.
- Nova: nominate infra contact for SSO and network access.
- Redwood: we will share the draft POC plan (attached) and the ops checklist.

Attachments: nova_poc_plan_v1.pdf (POC plan & milestones), poc-ops-checklist.xlsx (ops items).

If this looks good I'll send a calendar invite for the kickoff (11/29) and open the HubSpot milestone.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@novasoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Barnes <claire.barnes@novasoft.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones - Nova Software

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful and aligned with our goals. A couple of quick notes: 

- Success criteria: the quality pass rate target of 85% is fine; can we include an additional check for hallucination on the structured-response prompts (we'll flag those in the eval set)?
- Evaluation set: I can get the 250 queries over to you by COB 11/24; Claire will own that.
- Nova infra contact: sending the SSO/infra owner on this thread — Claire will intro our SRE if needed, but I expect the contact to be me initially.

Confirming kickoff on 11/29 works. Please send the invite and any pre-read.

Best,
Sanjay
Head of AI, Nova Software
sanjay@novasoft.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T12:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & milestones - Nova Software (internal)

Quick internal notes after the call:
- Need to confirm expected input distribution (token lengths, typical prompt shapes) from Nova before we set batching and KV cache heuristics. Ask them to tag the eval set with prompt length buckets.
- For the staging environment we should reserve a small dedicated pool for the trial to hit latency SLOs — recommend reserving 1 ded GPU instance (A10x variant) for the first two weeks and then scale as needed.
- Connor action: prepare a short Ops checklist for onboarding (I attached poc-ops-checklist.xlsx to this thread).
- Michael: can you confirm estimated cost impact for the reserved pool so we can include it in the internal cost estimate for the deal?

I'll be on the kickoff and can lead the tuning sessions.

-Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone,

Updated plan based on Sanjay/Connor notes:
- Added hallucination/structured-response check to the quality criteria.
- Connor will lead tuning and will ask Nova to annotate the eval set with length buckets.
- Michael: please reply with cost estimate for the reserved staging pool by EOD 11/23 so we can finalize internal approvals.

I created the kickoff calendar for 2026-11-29 at 10:00am PT and attached the POC plan (nova_poc_plan_v1.pdf). Invite includes a 60-minute slot; agenda in the invite: introductions (10m), infra/access (10m), eval & success criteria (15m), integration steps (15m), next steps & owners (10m).

Next steps summary:
- Nova: share eval set + 10 priority prompts (due 11/24).
- Redwood: confirm staging capacity cost (Michael) and share final POC plan (done).
- Everyone: join kickoff on 11/29.

Looking forward to it,
